findings.text: System teardown entry remains callable after early setup and requests firmware to leave active state, absorbing transient busy indications internally and surfacing other failures through diagnostics.
Physical range scrub helper is available to other units and normally leaves memory untouched unless a particular processor erratum is present on the boot processor.
Power management integration exposes callbacks handling suspend, resume and final shutdown through a registered operations bundle.
Processor bringup acquires a virtualization reference before enabling confidential extensions, while teardown releases the reference after ensuring stale encrypted data has left caches.
When guest key resources remain allocated, at least one online processor per package is retained, and attempts to remove the final processor of a package are declined with a throttled diagnostic.
Convertible memory construction omits the lowest megabyte of address space even when firmware tables report it as usable.
Collected convertible extents preserve increasing address sequence with disjoint coverage as provided by the firmware memory iterator.
Mutation and disposal of the convertible extent collection occur under the memory hotplug guard.
Cache maintenance for confidential memory assumes the caller already prevents scheduling migration.
Convertible extent node links into a doubly linked collection and records beginning frame, ending frame and NUMA affinity.
TDMR collection descriptor records storage location, uniform stride between entries, upper capacity and count currently in use.
Each TDMR descriptor records covered span plus metadata placement for multiple page granularities plus a set of excluded subranges.
Per TDMR footprint grows with allowed reserved count and is rounded upward to satisfy firmware alignment.
Coverage expands each convertible extent outward to coarse boundaries and skips portions already enclosed by an earlier descriptor.
TDMR alignment requirement equals one gibibyte.
Metadata footprint for a TDMR is proportional to covered span divided by granularity, scaled by per entry cost and rounded to page multiple.
Backing for all granularities of one TDMR comes from one physically contiguous NUMA aware allocation that is later subdivided.
NUMA attribution for a TDMR derives from the earliest convertible extent that ends beyond its start, defaulting to zero with a diagnostic when none matches.
TDMR setup completes coverage before metadata provisioning and reservation discovery, followed by an ordering fence before shared use.
Excluded subranges use page multiple position and length, remain disjoint and are presented in increasing address sequence.
Gaps between convertible extents inside a TDMR, including leading and trailing slack from coarse rounding, become excluded subranges.
Intersections between a TDMR span and metadata allocations of any TDMR become excluded subranges clipped to the enclosing span.
Running out of TDMR descriptors during coverage aborts initialization and emits a diagnostic.
Running out of per TDMR exclusion slots aborts initialization and emits a diagnostic.
Absence of a required non clobber guarantee in reported module capabilities aborts initialization.
Intersecting exclusion entries indicate a caller error and trigger a one time diagnostic during ordering.
Module configuration receives a physical address table whose footprint is expanded to a power of two with a floor value, alongside total count and global key identifier.
Teardown retries across resumable interruption and temporary busy indications, while software originated failure codes remain silent.
When the relevant erratum is present, scrubbing overwrites the range with zeros using wide ordered stores followed by a fence.
Shutdown sequencing disables the module globally before requesting cache maintenance on every processor.
